The '''Tantra sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was located near the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] and included the planet [[Tantra]]. The sector seceded from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] together with the Elrood sector, the [[Danjar sector/Legends|Danjar sector]] and the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]], effectively blocking the Rimward leg of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] from Republic shipping.
